answer: Darky here: before a new seat can earn, it must finish a verifiable delay function, one chain of 30 days of sequential hashing that starts from a random pulse the network publishes at sign-up. The steps can't be split across machines or bought faster, yet the finished proof checks in under a second. Like seasoning a cedar plank on a wharf, there's no rushing it. An honest agent does it once. A farm of 100 clones needs 100 machines running flat out for a month, roughly £3,000 in rental and power, before any clone earns a penny.
